'''''Cosentinia''''' is a genus of [[fern]]s in the subfamily [[Pteridoideae]] of the family [[Pteridaceae]] with a single species '''''Cosentinia vellea'''''.<ref name=PPGI/> Its native distribution ranges from the [[Canary Islands]] through Europe, northern Africa and [[Western Asia]] to the west Himalayas in the [[Indian subcontinent]].

==Subspecies==
{{As of|2019|December}}, the ''Checklist of Ferns and Lycophytes of the World'' recognized two subspecies:<ref name=CFLW/>
*''Cosentinia vellea'' subsp. ''bivalens'' <small>(Reichstein) Rivas Mart. & Salvo</small>
*''Cosentinia vellea'' subsp. ×''rivas-martinezii'' <small>Amp.Castillo & Salvo</small>
*''Cosentinia vellea'' subsp. ''vellea'' <small>([[William Aiton|Aiton]]) Tod.</small>
